cohort: The study included 60 women who experienced spontaneous term delivery and 60 women who had spontaneous preterm delivery (gestational age of less than 37 weeks).
finding: Women who experienced spontaneous preterm delivery had significantly higher scores for total psychological disorders and all subscales compared to women with term delivery.
cross-section timing: During 2014, psychological disorders were examined in women who had experienced spontaneous term or preterm delivery.
gest_age: less than 37 weeks (preterm group); implicitly 37 weeks or more (term group)
